data.content: The Lunar Foundation series (3 books): "Moon Rock" (Book 1), "Mooncoming" (Book 2), "Waters End" (Book 3) — near-future hard sci-fi about a moon colony's founding, growth, and water crisis. Separate from No Blue Sky series. Directory: /home/bob/books/Moon_Base_Series/

Character naming convention: All book characters must use first names from the top 50 most common US names (SSA data). Never use ethnically-diverse or AI-typical names like Elena, Diego, Mei-Lin, Rajiv, Jean-Luc, Aisha, Ana, Kenji. The Lunar Foundation series uses: Margaret Vasquez, Elizabeth Chen, Robert Patel, Christopher Dubois, Michael Morales, Susan Hassan, James Okonkwo, Sarah Torres, Barbara Mikhailova, Richard Tanaka, David Webb.

Dashboard at http://192.168.1.77:5543/pipeline-dashboard.html. 4 sections: Books Catalog (10 books), SaaS Apps (GitHub+prod+local links), Virtual Consulting (3 tiers + modal), Lead & Promotion pipeline stats + outreach. Server at ~/.hermes/pipeline-engine/dashboard/
9 pipeline ops with skills arrays in dashboard. Pipeline-skills mapping stored at pipeline-dashboard.html. CEO orchestrator skill has Pipeline Registry table.

All book writing — every series, every project — must use the humanized writing style: no AI-isms, no filler, real voice, variable rhythm, opinions where they fit, first-person when honest. Call out any LLM-sounding language in all manuscripts, not just in feedback to the user.

Cover preferences: title 80% width, single-line if short, bold sans-serif. Author ALWAYS "Bob J Mills". No subtitles/taglines. "Inspired by [Book X]" = genre/style only, NOT visual elements. Water/hope themes need BRIGHT art, not dark.

Publishing package delivery preference: send individual files (PDF, EPUB, cover JPEG) as separate Telegram media links, not just the ZIP. ZIP is for archival; user wants to open and inspect the actual files.

Prolific sci-fi author (No Blue Sky, Lunar Foundation). Telegram — brief, directive, expects batch execution ("do the same to all"). Demands: best-selling prose, professional covers (bold 80%-width stacked sans-serif title + "Bob J Mills"), bright/contrasty original art. Corrects bluntly on wrong author names, unwanted subtitles, or copied book elements. No subtitles under title unless asked. Covers "inspired by" best-sellers must use COMPLETELY ORIGINAL elements. Expects proactive QA after builds. 180-200pp target per book.

**HUMANIZATION IS MANDATORY FOR ALL BOOKS** — This is not optional or occasional. Every single piece of book prose in every project/series (writing, editing, rewriting, publishing, front/back matter, transitions, bridges, descriptions) MUST load and apply the `humanizer` skill's 29 pattern checks. No AI-isms, no filler, real voice, variable rhythm, opinions where they fit, first-person when honest. Call out any LLM-sounding language in all manuscripts. This rule is permanent and applies automatically — the user should never need to remind me.
